# Kanvaz

> Kanvaz is a free, open-source (MIT), 100% offline reference board for VFX, 3D and game artists: an infinite canvas for images, video, audio, 3D models, PDFs and PureRef boards, with Map View, always-on-top beside ZBrush and Blender, and no account. Made by Atharva Patil (p4inz, P4INZ, painz), P4inz Interactive Labs.

- Guide: {{ '/guide/' | absolute_url }}
- Download: https://github.com/p4inz-code/kanvaz/releases/latest
- Source: https://github.com/p4inz-code/kanvaz
- Kanvaz Mini (smaller version): {{ '/guide/kanvaz-mini.html' | absolute_url }}
- More by the author, all projects: {{ '/guide/more-by-p4inz.html' | absolute_url }}
